description: This file initializes the 'fal' subpackage within the pipecat.services module, sets up deprecated module proxying, and imports all symbols from 'image' and 'stt' submodules. It also registers a proxy for backward compatibility or deprecation handling.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A class used to create a proxy for deprecated modules to warn or redirect usage, facilitating transition to new module structures.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class, which sets up a wrapper around the module's globals to monitor or modify attribute access.
